integrity_statement: Finite tests corroborate but do not prove infinite limits; known prior specializations are expressly credited; no independent review was performed.
scientific_limitations: Coefficient-defined analytic Hilbert scale and monomial maps only; filtration trace is not an ordinary trace. The unweighted Bergman specialization has previously published point spectra. An equivalent broader historical result remains a risk.
title: Weak-trace spectral defect of power composition on Dirichlet-type Hilbert scales
